title: Personal Loans Refinance Pricing Memo: Remaining-Term Credit on the Refinance Fee
content:
## Rule

A remaining-term credit comes off the refinance fee percent of a Personal Loans refinance application, counting the installments still to run on the loan being refinanced from its next due date through its maturity date with both dates counted: more than 24 remaining earn 0.5 point; 13 to 24 remaining earn 0.25 point; 12 or fewer remaining earn no remaining-term credit.

| Installments still to run | Credit off the refinance fee percent |
|---|---|
| more than 24 | 0.50 point |
| 13 to 24 | 0.25 point |
| 12 or fewer | none |

A point is a percentage point of the fee percent. The refinance fee percent, with this credit taken off, never goes below zero.

## Counting (hypothetical loans, installments due on the 1st)

| Next due date | Maturity date | Installments, both dates counted | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 1 April two years later | 24 | 0.25 |
| 1 May | 1 May two years later | 25 | 0.50 |
| 1 May | 1 April of the next year | 12 | none |
| 1 May | 1 May of the next year | 13 | 0.25 |
